title: Avo-4-part-1
description: Comprehensive exam covering aircraft batteries, DC generators, voltage regulation, DC alternators, and related electrical systems.

questions.question: Battery source is
questions.explanation: A battery supplies direct current because its chemical reaction establishes a fixed polarity between its positive and negative terminals.

questions.question: Battery voltage decrease to 10.5V with 6 cells
questions.explanation: For a six-cell lead-acid battery, a terminal voltage around 10.5 V indicates that the battery has reached a fully discharged condition.

questions.question: Not an advantage of Ni-cad over lead acid
options: C. Better performance at high discharge rates
questions.explanation: Less weight is not normally considered an advantage of Ni-Cd over lead-acid batteries in aircraft battery comparisons.

questions.question: Which method takes longer to charge
questions.explanation: Constant current charging supplies a controlled current throughout the charging process and generally requires more time than rapid charging methods.

questions.question: Voltage regulator on modern light aircraft
questions.explanation: Modern light aircraft commonly use solid-state voltage regulators because they have no mechanical contacts and provide reliable voltage control.

questions.question: Separately excited DC generator requires current from
questions.explanation: A separately excited generator receives its field current from an external DC power source rather than from its own generated output.

questions.question: Active material in Ni-cad battery
questions.explanation: Cadmium is one of the active electrode materials used in a nickel-cadmium battery.

questions.question: NiCad battery with combination of high battery Tº and overcharging
questions.explanation: High battery temperature combined with overcharging can increase charging current and temperature further, producing thermal runaway.

questions.question: When a circuit is connected to lead acid, electron flow is from
questions.explanation: In the external circuit, conventional electron flow is from the negative terminal toward the positive terminal.

questions.question: Positive plate of anode in Ni-cad
questions.explanation: The positive electrode of a nickel-cadmium cell contains nickel compounds that participate in the electrochemical reaction.

questions.question: Freezed battery subjected to high charge rate may
questions.explanation: Charging a frozen battery at a high rate can cause dangerous internal pressure and damage, creating a risk of explosion.

questions.question: Which battery is known for high energy desity
questions.explanation: Lithium batteries are known for high energy density, allowing substantial stored energy for relatively low weight.

questions.question: Ni-cad batteries electrolyte is
questions.explanation: Nickel-cadmium batteries use an alkaline electrolyte consisting primarily of potassium hydroxide and distilled water.

questions.question: Amount of electrical energy that a cell can provide from new to the end of its useful voltage on load
questions.explanation: Cell capacity represents the amount of electrical charge or energy that a cell can deliver during its useful discharge period.

questions.question: Which voltage regulator has moving parts
questions.explanation: Carbon-pile voltage regulators use mechanical movement to vary the resistance of a carbon pile and therefore contain moving parts.

questions.question: Is used in field excited type Dc generator
questions.explanation: Field-excited DC generators use electromagnetic field windings to establish the magnetic field required for generation.

questions.question: What connection used to have equal voltage bin field winding and armature winding
questions.explanation: In a shunt connection, the field winding is connected across the armature output, so the field winding and armature terminals have the same voltage.

questions.question: Which of the following doesn't directly affect the output of the generator
questions.explanation: Field strength and rotational speed directly influence generated EMF. The armature type itself does not directly determine the generator output in the same manner.

questions.question: A battery used for high capacity and high discharge rate
questions.explanation: Vented nickel-cadmium batteries are suitable for aircraft applications requiring high capacity and high discharge capability.

questions.question: Negative plate after discharge in Ni-cad becomes
questions.explanation: During discharge, the negative electrode reaction in a Ni-Cd cell involves cadmium compounds, with the discharged negative material becoming cadmium hydroxide and associated reaction products.

questions.question: Which terminal should we disconnect first
options: C. Both at the same time
questions.explanation: The negative terminal is normally disconnected first to reduce the risk of an accidental short circuit between the positive terminal and the aircraft structure.

questions.question: Types of DC generator used in laboratory
questions.explanation: A separately excited DC generator is commonly used for laboratory study because its field excitation can be independently controlled.

questions.question: Commutator segments of a DC generator are part of (Rotating part in DC)
questions.explanation: The commutator rotates with the armature and is electrically connected to the armature windings.

questions.question: Voltage generated by a basic generator
questions.explanation: A basic generator produces alternating voltage because the induced EMF reverses direction as the conductors rotate through opposite magnetic poles.

questions.question: Current in armature conductors of a DC generator
options: B. Pure DC before the commutator
questions.explanation: The current induced in the rotating armature conductors alternates in direction. The commutator mechanically rectifies it to provide DC at the output.

questions.question: DC generators are
questions.explanation: DC generators used in aircraft and electrical systems can be self-excited, where the generator supplies its own field excitation after voltage builds up.

questions.question: Method of restoring generator field residual magnetism
questions.explanation: Flashing the field applies an external DC source to restore the residual magnetism needed for voltage build-up.

questions.question: Ni-cad cells installed in
questions.explanation: Aircraft nickel-cadmium batteries may use vented cells that allow gases produced during charging to be managed through the venting system.

questions.question: What will happen to output voltage as electric load increase self exited DC
options: A. Remains exactly constant without regulation
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Increase. Generator output voltage is influenced by load, field excitation, speed, and the voltage regulation system.

questions.question: Capacity of battery is free of
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Internal resistance. Battery capacity is normally expressed as the amount of charge a battery can deliver under specified conditions.

questions.question: Capacity of Ni-Cd battery not affected
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Under/over filling. Battery capacity depends on operating and charging conditions, while electrolyte level must also be maintained correctly.

questions.question: Increasing the no of armature coil
options: A. Reduce the variation bin maximum/minimum voltage
questions.explanation: Increasing the number of armature coils provides more overlapping generated voltage contributions and helps reduce the variation between maximum and minimum output voltage.

questions.question: The armature reaction doesn't
options: A. Distort the main magnetic field
C. Shift the magnetic neutral plane
questions.explanation: Armature reaction distorts and can weaken the main magnetic field, but it does not completely eliminate the main flux.

questions.question: Using auxiliary poles bin the main poles used to
questions.explanation: Auxiliary or interpoles provide a magnetic field that counteracts the effects of armature reaction in the commutation zone.

questions.question: Seriesly connect with Armature winding & produce opposite armature current
questions.explanation: Compensating windings are connected in series with the armature circuit and produce a magnetic effect opposing armature reaction.

questions.question: The armature connected on hallow iron core
questions.explanation: Ring winding is associated with conductors wound around a ring-shaped or hollow iron armature core.

questions.question: If battery is fully discharging and not changed immediately
options: B. The electrolyte becomes pure water
C. The plates become permanently magnetized
questions.explanation: If a lead-acid battery remains deeply discharged, lead sulfate can form larger crystals, producing sulfation and reducing battery performance.

questions.question: Not disadvantage of ni-cd battery over lead acid
options: C. More tolerant of repeated cycling
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Less long life. Nickel-cadmium batteries are generally recognized for good cycle life, particularly under repeated discharge and recharge conditions.

questions.question: Rotary electrical component that periodically reverse the current discharge bin rotor & electric circuit
questions.explanation: The commutator periodically reverses the electrical connection of the armature coils so that the external output remains unidirectional.

questions.question: Basic generative output
questions.explanation: A basic DC generator produces pulsating DC at its output because the commutator mechanically rectifies the alternating armature EMF.

questions.question: Dc alternator control unit
options: A. Current limiter and voltage regulator
questions.explanation: The DC alternator control system includes voltage regulation and current-limiting functions to control generator output and protect the system.

questions.question: False about NiCd
options: A. It uses an alkaline electrolyte
B. release K from the electrolyte
C. It uses cadmium as an electrode material
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is release K from the electrolyte. Nickel-cadmium battery chemistry uses potassium hydroxide electrolyte and does not normally describe potassium as an active electrode product.

questions.question: Series generator
options: B. has less no of winding
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is less no of winding. A series generator has its field winding connected in series with the armature and load.

questions.question: As to Electromagnetic field is proportional to
questions.explanation: The strength of an electromagnetic field produced by a coil is related to the current through the coil and the number of turns.

questions.question: Chemical rxn takes place and current and enters in to the call is
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is electrode. Electrodes are the conductive elements where electrochemical reactions take place and current enters or leaves the cell.

questions.question: __ use specific gravity to determine state of change
questions.explanation: The specific gravity of the electrolyte in a lead-acid battery changes with its state of charge and can therefore be used as an indication of charge condition.

questions.question: __ to measure specific gravity of liquid
questions.explanation: A hydrometer measures the specific gravity of a liquid by determining the density of the liquid relative to water.

questions.question: What does it mean high resistance field coil in self-excite dc generator
options: B. Low resistance with fewer turns
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is tm coil (and more turn). A high-resistance field winding is associated with a larger number of turns of relatively fine wire.

questions.question: When gassing occurs some of water absorbed by plate, to protect this action
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is water adjustment. In serviceable battery systems, electrolyte or water level is maintained according to the manufacturer's maintenance procedure.

questions.question: Specific gravity of Ni-cd is less than
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is 1300. Nickel-cadmium electrolyte has a specific gravity lower than the values associated with concentrated sulfuric acid electrolyte.

questions.question: Li-ion unique from others by
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Galvanic rxn. Lithium-ion cells operate through electrochemical reactions involving movement of lithium ions between the electrodes.

questions.question: For long duration to storage battery, connecting -ve & +ve by shortening is called
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Dip cycle. The term is retained exactly as provided in the question source.

questions.question: Mechanical supper for armature bearing and feed magnetic flux for the pole
questions.explanation: The end frame provides mechanical support for the armature bearings and forms part of the magnetic circuit around the generator.

questions.question: Modern generator control
questions.explanation: Modern generator control systems commonly use solid-state electronics because they provide accurate and reliable regulation without mechanical contacts.

questions.question: End of first coil connected to the next coil under Main pole
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Wave winding. In wave winding, successive coils are connected so the winding progresses around the armature in a wave-like pattern.

questions.question: Induced EMF in DC generator requires
options: A. Magnetic field, conductive material & relative motion
questions.explanation: Electromagnetic induction requires a magnetic field, a conductor, and relative motion between the conductor and magnetic field.

questions.question: The voltage measurement without connected load to the battery is called
questions.explanation: Open-circuit voltage is the voltage measured across a battery when no external load is connected and essentially no load current is flowing.

questions.question: The first to do when removing a generator
questions.explanation: Disconnecting external electrical power first prevents accidental energization and reduces the risk of electrical injury or equipment damage.

questions.question: The first thing to do when removing a battery
options: C. Connect the positive terminal to ground
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is master charger off. Removing the charging source first prevents the battery from remaining connected to an active charging circuit.

questions.question: The electrolyte in the lead acid battery is
options: B. H2SO4 diluted with pure distilled water
questions.explanation: A lead-acid battery uses sulfuric acid diluted with distilled water as its electrolyte.

questions.question: Positive electrode of lithium ion battery
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Carbon / graphite. This answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: The prod of lead acid battery
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is lead oxide. Lead compounds form the active materials of the positive and negative plates in lead-acid battery chemistry.

questions.question: In shunt connection as loud increase
options: B. Field current becomes zero immediately
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is field current decrease. The field circuit in a shunt generator is connected across the generator output and is therefore affected by changes in terminal voltage.

questions.question: Doesn't affect the strength of magnetic field
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is amount of voltage. Magnetic field strength is directly related to ampere-turns, while voltage affects field strength indirectly by influencing current.

questions.question: When lithium ion charge, the ion lithium goes from
questions.explanation: During charging, lithium ions move through the electrolyte from the positive electrode toward the negative electrode.

questions.question: __ houses Armature conductor in dc generator
questions.explanation: The armature core contains slots in which the armature conductors are placed and also provides a magnetic path for the generated flux.

questions.question: Lap winding definition
options: A. is rotating conductor load DC to DC
B. Connects armature coils so each coil overlaps or 'laps' the preceding coil
C. Uses only stationary field coils
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is is rotating conductor load DC to DC. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Fully charged nicd cells, the voltage is
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is 1.2 volts (CCV). A nickel-cadmium cell has a nominal voltage of approximately 1.2 V.

questions.question: What happens if lead acid cells voltage are below 10.5V
options: C. The battery becomes fully charged
questions.explanation: A lead-acid battery discharged to a very low voltage can suffer severe damage, including sulfation and loss of usable capacity.

questions.question: Not correct about Armature rxn
options: A. It distorts the main field
B. It shifts the neutral plane
questions.explanation: Armature reaction can distort and weaken the main field, but it does not completely eliminate the main field.

questions.question: What term is given by the Armature flux on mam field
questions.explanation: The effect of armature flux on the main field flux is called armature reaction.

questions.question: Is disadvantage of lithium ion
questions.explanation: High cost is a commonly recognized disadvantage of lithium-ion battery technology compared with some conventional battery types.

questions.question: Is disadvantage of Nicad battery over lead acid
options: B. Higher maintenance requirements in some applications
C. Better resistance to repeated cycling
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is less weight. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Lead acid ___ 1300
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is lower than. The specific gravity value depends on the electrolyte condition and battery state.

questions.question: Charging method of NiCad battery
questions.explanation: Nickel-cadmium batteries are commonly charged using controlled constant-current charging methods.

questions.question: State of charge of nicad battery is determined by
options: A. Measuring electrolyte specific gravity only
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is measuring voltage value. Ni-Cd state of charge can be assessed using voltage measurements under appropriate test conditions.

questions.question: Probable cause of burn mourns or signs of overheating on coil links
questions.explanation: Loose electrical links can create increased contact resistance, producing localized heating and possible burning or overheating marks.

questions.question: Reaction not occur in lead acid during discharging
options: C. Conversion of active plate materials
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Electrolyte gams sot. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Disadvantage of li-ion battery
options: A. High cost and sensitive of flammable high Tº
questions.explanation: The supplied answer identifies high cost and sensitivity to high temperature and flammability as disadvantages of lithium-ion batteries.

questions.question: The negative plate in lead acid battery is
questions.explanation: The negative plate of a charged lead-acid battery consists primarily of spongy lead.

questions.question: Pole pieces of shoes in DC are part of the
questions.explanation: The pole pieces and pole shoes form part of the field assembly and provide the magnetic path for the field flux.

questions.question: Generator control with no moving parts and with reliable and better system regulation
questions.explanation: Solid-state generator controls have no mechanical moving parts and provide reliable and accurate electrical regulation.

questions.question: Proper removal of generator
options: A. Disconnect External power before removal
B. Remove the armature while energized
C. Increase generator output before disconnecting
questions.explanation: External electrical power should be disconnected before generator removal to prevent accidental energization and electrical hazards.

questions.question: Type of DC generator assembly used in light aircraft
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is shunt wound. In a shunt generator, the field winding is connected in parallel with the armature output.

questions.question: Over Tº switch used to keep the battery from overheating in Li-ion battery
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is positive Temperature coefficient switch. Temperature-sensing and protection devices are used to protect lithium-ion batteries from excessive temperature.

questions.question: Pole shoes provide
questions.explanation: Pole shoes spread the magnetic flux over the required area of the air gap and provide a suitable magnetic path.

questions.question: Battery capacity AH depends on
options: A. The sea of the plates
B. The color of the casing
C. The number of terminals only
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is the sea of the plates. The answer is preserved as supplied in the source.

questions.question: Bar-Bar to opens or
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Glower to shorts. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Part of PC generator consist pole core and pole field
questions.explanation: The field structure contains the pole cores and associated field components that establish the magnetic field of the generator.

questions.question: Area of plate increase
questions.explanation: Increasing the active plate area increases the amount of active material available for electrochemical reaction and therefore increases battery capacity.

questions.question: Cathode plate of (li-ion
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Lithium Cobalt. Lithium cobalt oxide is a commonly used cathode material in lithium-ion cells.

questions.question: Short & open to check not used (which method of testing is not practically to tas ground, short and open circuit)
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is insulation. Insulation testing is used to assess unwanted leakage or electrical connection between conductors and ground.

questions.question: For vibrating type voltage regulator when overheating when opens
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Opens. Opening the regulating contacts interrupts or changes the field circuit to control excessive generator voltage.

questions.question: Which of the following is most reactive element
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is lithium ion. The answer is preserved as provided in the source.

questions.question: Outer frame of generator is
questions.explanation: The yoke forms the outer frame of a DC generator, provides mechanical support, and provides part of the magnetic return path.

questions.question: What is the drawback of DC generator
options: A. Dc pulsating which cause hamming
B. It produces no electrical output
C. It cannot contain a magnetic field
questions.explanation: The supplied answer identifies pulsating DC as a drawback. The commutated output of a DC generator contains ripple rather than being perfectly constant.

questions.question: What would be done of contact point of vibrating type voltage regulator when the generator voltage rise above a certain critical value
questions.explanation: When generator voltage rises above the regulating value, the vibrating contacts operate to reduce field excitation and control the generator voltage.

questions.question: Which of the following is arrent construction method
questions.explanation: Drum winding is the commonly used armature construction method in modern DC machines because the conductors are arranged effectively around the armature core.

questions.question: What type of change is used when the battery is on storage
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is trickle change. A low-rate maintenance charge can be used during storage when permitted by the battery manufacturer's procedure.

questions.question: How many voltage value must be used in order to change a lead acid battery wells after discharged for some time (12V ->12.6V)
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is > 13.6. The answer is preserved as provided in the source.

questions.question: In dc generator self-excited depending on the connection of fixed winding w armature is classified in to
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is 3. Self-excited DC generators are classified according to the field connection with the armature.

questions.question: Which control unit is used to convert motor to generative operation
questions.explanation: Generator control units manage generator operation and regulate electrical output when a machine operates as a generator.

questions.question: Ac to Dc conversion in Dc Alternator is done by
questions.explanation: AC is converted to DC by rectification. Modern aircraft DC alternators commonly use solid-state rectifiers for this function.

questions.question: When Nicad is not allowable and lead acid is fully changed, can be used with some correction
options: A. can be used with some correction
C. Must be replaced with a lithium battery
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is can be used with some correction. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: DC generator used on modern light aircraft
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is DC Alternator. Alternator-based generating systems with rectification are widely used in modern light aircraft.

questions.question: Prevent over heating Li-ion battery
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is over Tº switch. Temperature protection is used to disconnect or control charging when lithium-ion battery temperature becomes excessive.

questions.question: DC alternator & their related control are found on
options: A. Modern light piston engine aircraft
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is modern light piston engine aircraft. Alternator systems are commonly used on light aircraft to supply electrical power.

questions.question: Which voltage regulator has no moving parts
questions.explanation: A transistorized voltage regulator uses electronic components rather than mechanical contacts, so it has no moving regulating parts.

questions.question: How does armature reaction cause brush arcing
options: A. By moving the natural axis away from the brush
B. By stopping all armature current
questions.explanation: Armature reaction shifts the magnetic neutral plane away from its normal position, causing improper commutation and potentially producing brush arcing.

questions.question: Generator control voltage is more accurate & reliable
questions.explanation: Solid-state regulators provide more precise and reliable voltage control because they avoid mechanical contact wear.

questions.question: The use of pole shoe is for spreading out of the flux in the air gap uniform and support the field
options: B. Spreading out of the flux in the air gap uniform
questions.explanation: Pole shoes distribute the magnetic flux over the air gap more uniformly and provide mechanical support for the field structure.

questions.question: Which chemical is not used in NiCd battery electrolyte as a neutralizing agent
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is sodium carbonate. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Probable cause of output Voltage being too low
options: A. Prime mover speed is too low.
questions.explanation: Generator output voltage depends on rotational speed and field excitation. If prime mover speed is too low, the generated EMF can fall below the required value.

questions.question: Change that occurs when conductor's pass out of the influence of N-pole and enter S-pole
questions.explanation: As an armature conductor moves from the influence of one magnetic pole to the opposite pole, the direction of induced EMF reverses.

questions.question: Test carried on armature winding of DC generator for short circuit. Glower test
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is Glower test. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: DC generation with constant output power type
questions.explanation: The supplied answer is shunt wound DC. The answer is preserved exactly as provided in the source.

questions.question: Fun of Zener diode in transistorized voltage regulator
questions.explanation: A Zener diode provides a relatively stable reference voltage that the regulator circuit uses to control and stabilize the output voltage.

questions.question: General type inspection of rechargeable battery is considered
questions.explanation: Routine inspection of a rechargeable battery is preventive maintenance because it is performed to detect problems before they cause failure.
